newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 4.6 billion yuan from 2.5 billion yuan on Thursday with the 20-day contract the most active.
Traders said some state-owned banks in need of funds during the Chinese New Year holiday had increased their buying on Friday.
"State banks need to build up enough positions ahead of the holiday when the market will close," a trader said.
The market will close from February 7-12 for the annual Lunar New Year vacation.
Traders expect trading volume to decline next week as the holiday nears.
